The first two clauses are the same fact - the parent block states that Baer-* fails exactly where H_n(q) ceases to be semisimple, i.e. exactly where Wedderburn fails - and the third is not a failure at all but a change of regime, so the parallel structure is doing work the content does not support.

trap-superlative.evidence: "Therefore, the Volume Conjecture's archimedean asymptotic regime exactly traces the trajectory through the Baer-*-failure locus." The unqualified "exactly traces" is refuted by the two bullets it claims to follow from: bullet 2 says q = zeta_N "MAY fall outside the failure locus" for N >> n and that the Hecke order "EVENTUALLY" enters it. Those support "eventually enters", not "exactly traces the trajectory". The next sentence compounds it: "The loss of Baer-* projection-generation supplies the structural mechanism of the wall-crossing transition" asserts a mechanism, definite article and all, that nothing in the block derives.
